data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_path): DROP dual-store partial-failure semantics: (1) ORDER: tracker write first (source of truth per CLAUDE.md), PR write second (best-effort mirror); (2) ROLLBACK: if PR write fails after tracker succeeded, DO NOT roll back tracker (tracker is authoritative); (3) ESCALATION: PR write failure does NOT escalate finding to BLOCK; (4) OBSERVABILITY: emit structured stderr 'drop_pr_store_failed finding_hash=<h>' on PR write failure. Add test_arbiter_processor_drop_pr_store_failure_does_not_block to verify these semantics.
